title: GenGait: A Transformer-Based Model for Human Gait Anomaly Detection and Normative Twin Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.01997v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Gait analysis provides an objective characterization of locomotor function and is widely used to support diagnosis and rehabilitation monitoring across neurological and orthopedic disorders. Deep learning has been increasingly applied to this domain, yet most approaches rely on supervised classifiers trained on disease-labeled data, limiting generalization to heterogeneous pathological presentations. The methodological objective of this work is to develop a label-free framework for joint-level anomaly detection and kinematic correction based on a Transformer masked autoencoder trained exclusively on normative gait sequences from 150 adults, acquired with a markerless multi-camera motion-capture system.   At inference, a two-pass procedure is applied to potentially pathological input sequences: first, it estimates joint inconsistency scores by occluding individual joints and measuring deviations from the learned normative prior. translated_title: GenGait：一种基于Transformer的人体步态异常检测与规范性孪生生成模型
translated_abstract: 步态分析为运动功能提供了客观的表征，被广泛用于支持神经系统疾病和骨科疾病的诊断与康复监测。深度学习在这一领域的应用日益增多，但大多数方法依赖于在疾病标注数据上训练的监督分类器，这限制了对异质性病理表现的泛化能力。本研究的方法学目标是开发一个无需标签的框架，用于关节级别的异常检测和运动学矫正，该框架基于Transformer掩码自编码器，仅使用150名成年人的规范性步态序列进行训练，数据通过无标记的多摄像机动作捕捉系统采集。在推理阶段，对潜在的病理输入序列采用两遍处理流程：首先，通过遮挡单个关节并测量其与习得的规范先验的偏差来估计关节不一致性评分。然后，（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Transformer掩码自编码器的无标签步态异常检测框架GenGait，仅使用健康人群的规范性步态数据训练，即可实现关节级别的异常检测与运动学矫正，并生成规范性孪生序列。
en_tdlr: GenGait is a label-free Transformer masked autoencoder framework trained solely on normative gait sequences, enabling joint-level gait anomaly detection and kinematic correction through normative twin generation without requiring disease-labeled data.
